analysis.visual_description: On the tables. The tables lie open on the desk at the lodging. The street is not in the frame. A pen rests in the gutter of the leaf. No hand.
On the tables. A corner of the comedy's last leaf, brought home from yesterday. One short line in the margin. A softer ending is begun and struck.
On the tables. The same tables. No sum is added. The Cheapside line is a memorandum.
